bugs.what: Multi-step directional hints ('three north, then two east') from bearings/quest text sometimes didn't match the actual room graph exactly (e.g. Iron Downs spoil-field detour, Flooded Quarry route), requiring an extra free 'get your bearings' call to re-orient.

Den/lair encounters (wolf den, lynx Denhollow, slag-hound Flooded Quarry) reuse near-identical room names, descriptions and loot text across different hollows, making it feel copy-pasted rather than distinct.
bugs.where: Thornwold Denhollow / Iron Downs Flooded Quarry

bugs.what: Several collected lore/evidence items (curling survey map, cipher notes, causeway-stone/mere's-answer evidence for the Kings' Rest name-puzzle) were flagged as relevant to quests but never had a clear action to actually consume them before the run ended, leaving it unclear if they were needed.

confusions: It's not obvious at first that 'travel to a known place' vs. raw compass directions cover different graphs (landmarks vs. every room) until you've used it a few times.
Some multi-step travel hints given by NPCs (e.g. 'two stands west, then one north') don't map 1:1 onto the single-step room links actually presented, causing a couple of wrong turns.

It's not signposted up front that crossing Coldpass permanently locks out unfinished companion/hold threads until you're already at the gate with the warning — by then most players will have accumulated many open threads.
suggestions: Make 'get your bearings' hints match the actual per-room exit chain exactly, or auto-offer a multi-step 'travel to' option for named distant landmarks even before they're 'known'.
Vary the flavor text/room names for repeated den/lair mini-dungeons so they don't read as reused templates.
Add a one-line reminder earlier in Act II (not just at the Coldpass gate) that companion/faction threads close permanently after crossing, so players can pace exploration accordingly.
Surface a short in-fiction hint for exactly how/when collected 'evidence' items (survey maps, ciphers) get used, since some can be carried the whole game without an obvious consumption point.
